name: Outlaw
attacks: Revolver +3 (1d8+1 piercing, 20/60, cap 6, MF 1), Bowie +3 (1d6+1 piercing)
description: Trail trash with a six-gun attitude: duster or short coat, bandana, cheap leather, a knife that fights like a scimitar and a belt gun or short carbine. Stagecoach robbers, road agents, and posse fodder.

name: Switch Boss
description: Rifleman who runs the rail-switch crew in Night at the Switch; fires a Dirty Henrietta from the handcar.
loot: Boss poke: 2 Yellow + 1 Green (250 ES). His rifle: Dirty Henrietta Repeating Rifle (.44-40) and leftover tube rounds, gear at PHB list (6,500 ES), not cash. Scene finds, not on him: tool box (Investigation DC 12) with a crowbar and a gun cleaning kit (100 ES gear); handcar lockbox (thieves' tools DC 12 or Str DC 15) with 1 Purple (500 ES) under 1 Black decoy.
tactics: Flees on the handcar when he is the last of the crew standing.
attacks: Dirty Rifle +3 (1d8+1 piercing, 30/120, 6 rds, MF 1-2), Bowie +3 (1d6+1 piercing)

attackList.name: Dirty Rifle
attackList.notes: Henrietta Repeating Rifle, Medium (.44-40), Dirty. Misfires on a natural 1-2: miss, jam, and the round is still spent. No close quarters: disadvantage with a hostile within 5 ft. Two-handed. Reload is an action; Tactical Reload loads 1 round as a bonus action.

attackList.name: Bowie
attackList.notes: Finesse, light. Only if a PC closes on the handcar.

traits.name: Dirty Rifle
traits.text: The rifle is Dirty: it misfires on at least 1-2 until someone cleans it (10 minutes with gunsmith's tools or a gun cleaning kit). A misfire misses and jams the rifle, and the round is still spent. It fouls (unusable until a short rest with tools, or 500 ES to a gunsmith) if both d20s show 1-2 on a roll with advantage or disadvantage, or if it gets dirty again.

traits.name: Handcar Nest (tactic)
traits.text: Stays on the handcar and fires the rifle, then uses Take Cover (bonus action) behind the handcar. Ranged attacks against him have disadvantage until his next attack, and firing ends it. There is no automatic cover from the handcar.

traits.name: Morale (tactic)
traits.text: When he is the last of the crew standing, he flees on the handcar. If he runs, the remaining outlaws surrender.

actions.name: Clear Jam
actions.text: Clears the jammed rifle with his action, or with a bonus action and a DC 10 Dexterity check (+1; no tool proficiency). A fouled rifle can't be cleared in the fight.

actions.name: Flee on the Handcar
actions.text: Morale break: he takes the handcar down the line and leaves the fight.

name: Cactus Witch

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.text: The cactus witch can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Innate Spellcasting
traits.text: Charisma (spell save DC 12). At will: dancing lights, minor illusion, vicious mockery.

traits.name: Mimicry
traits.text: The cactus witch can mimic animal sounds and humanoid voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful DC 14 Wisdom (Insight) check.

actions.name: Illusory Appearance
actions.text: The cactus witch covers herself with a magical illusion of another humanoid of her size. A creature must take an action and succeed on a DC 20 Intelligence (Investigation) check to discern the disguise.

actions.name: Invisible Passage
actions.text: The cactus witch magically turns invisible until she attacks or casts a spell, or until her concentration ends.

description: A sun-cracked crone in dust-colored robes and a wide brim stuck with dried herbs, cactus spines, and bone charms. She nests in abandoned mines, ghost towns, and canyon hollows.

name: Dust Devil

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.text: The dust devil has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.text: The dust devil has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the dust devil's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't incapacitated.

description: Lean prairie wolves the color of trail dust. Not air elementals. Locals nicknamed them Dust Devils for how a pack looks like a spinning cloud of dirt until the teeth arrive.
